name: vectis
title: Vectis
description: Control CPU and GPU power through the vectisd daemon: power profiles, a hard TDP cap and GPU mode switching. Needs the vectis CLI and vectisd running.
author: black

commands.name: vectis
commands.title: Vectis
commands.subtitle: Power profiles, TDP and GPU mode
commands.description: Everything vectisd controls, in one list: the three power profiles, GPU mode switching, a hard TDP cap and the diagnostics.

commands.name: set-powersave
commands.title: Set Powersave
commands.subtitle: Lowest power draw
commands.description: Switch to the powersave profile immediately, without opening a list.

commands.name: set-balanced
commands.title: Set Balanced
commands.subtitle: Scale up under load
commands.description: Switch to the balanced profile immediately, without opening a list.

commands.name: set-performance
commands.title: Set Performance
commands.subtitle: Hold boost clocks
commands.description: Switch to the performance profile immediately, without opening a list.

commands.name: gpu-mode
commands.title: GPU Mode
commands.subtitle: Integrated, hybrid or discrete
commands.description: Switch the GPU between integrated, hybrid and discrete, or apply the switch immediately.
